positioning: A multilingual digital-finance capability platform for institutions that need staff, leaders, customers or stakeholders to understand blockchain, digital assets, payments, fintech, cyber risk and compliance.

audiences.name: Banks & Payment Institutions
audiences.value: Board-to-frontline learning on digital assets, tokenisation, modern payments, fraud, cyber risk, governance and customer education.

audiences.name: Regulators, Central Banks & Public Institutions
audiences.value: Technology-neutral education that separates concepts, architectures and risks from product hype, with jurisdiction-specific regulatory overlays.

audiences.name: FinTech, Crypto & Technology Companies
audiences.value: Structured capability building across product, engineering, operations, compliance, customer support and leadership teams.

audiences.name: Audit, Accounting, Legal & Advisory Firms
audiences.value: Cross-disciplinary digital-finance literacy for professionals advising clients on transactions, controls, governance, reporting and risk.

audiences.name: Insurers & Risk Institutions
audiences.value: Capability in digital-asset exposures, cyber incidents, fraud patterns, custody risk and emerging technology governance.

audiences.name: Universities, Colleges & Training Networks
audiences.value: A modular professional-learning layer that can supplement existing programmes without claiming to replace the institution's own accredited qualifications.

audiences.name: Global Corporates & Industry Associations
audiences.value: Practical digital-finance literacy for treasury, finance, procurement, technology, risk, innovation and executive teams.

audiences.name: Development Finance, NGOs & Multilateral Programmes
audiences.value: Accessible learning for financial inclusion, digital payments, SME enablement, consumer protection and public-interest programmes.

deployment: Private deployment where commercially and technically approved
delivery.localisation: Interface, examples, assessments and learning content can be localised by language and jurisdiction. A locale is only advertised as fully available after its content pack has passed translation and subject-matter review.

commercial.model: Institutional licence, cohort fee or custom programme agreement
commercial.pricing: Quote-based until standard enterprise packages are approved
commercial.payment_rule: Institutional contracts and invoicing remain separate from consumer iKhokha checkout.
